fields.acceptance: A ship rebase testscript with a code conflict: the raised question has a blocks link to the change set; rhiza inbox --json lists it as a blocker of that change set; rhiza question answer <q> <words> --change <cs> writes the answer; raising it again on the same conflict writes nothing
fields.statement: A rebase-conflict question raised by ship rebase blocks the change set being shipped, so the inbox lists it as a blocker and rhiza question answer accepts it with --change
